description: An energy storage device modeled as a generic reservoir, suitable for charging and discharging with average efficiency losses across storage types and chemistries. For pumped hydro, see HydroPumpTurbine and HydroReservoir instead.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

available.description: Whether the component is online (true) or offline (false). Unavailable components are excluded from simulations.

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

prime_mover_type.description: Prime mover technology according to EIA 923.

storage_capacity.description: Maximum storage capacity, e.g. MWh for batteries or liters for hydrogen. Divided by base_power gives an approximate duration at unity power factor. Units: per energy_units — MWH: MWh, MWMIN: MWmin .

energy_units.description: Unit basis for `storage_capacity`. MWH is the default interchange form; MWMIN records the same energy on the minutes basis used by operational durations.

storage_level_limits.description: Minimum and maximum allowable storage levels [0, 1], usable to model derates or state-of-charge restrictions on cycling.

initial_storage_capacity_level.description: Initial storage capacity level as a ratio [0, 1.0] of `storage_capacity`. Units: 1.

rating.description: Maximum AC side output power rating of the unit. Not to be confused with base_power. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVA, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

active_power.description: Initial active power set point. The steady-state operating point for power flow; an optional starting point for other solvers. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

input_active_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum limits on the input active power (i.e., charging). Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

output_active_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum limits on the output active power (i.e., discharging). Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

efficiency.description: Average efficiency [0, 1] `in` (charging/filling) and `out` (discharging/consuming) of the storage system.

reactive_power.description: Initial reactive power set point of the unit. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

reactive_power_limits.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits. Set to `null` if not applicable. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

base_power.description: Base power of the unit for per unitization. Units: MVA.

power_units.description: Unit basis for this component's power fields (power, ratings, ramp rates): COMPONENT_BASE per unit on base_power, NATURAL_UNITS the field's own unit.

operation_cost.description: Operating cost of storage. or MarketBidCost

conversion_factor.description: Conversion factor of `storage_capacity` to MWh, if different than 1.0. For example, X MWh/liter hydrogen. Units: 1.

storage_target.description: Storage target at the end of simulation as ratio of storage capacity. Units: 1.

cycle_limits.description: Storage Maximum number of cycles per year. Units: 1.

ramp_limits.description: Ramp up and ramp down limits. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW/min, COMPONENT_BASE: pu/min .

self_discharge.description: Self-discharge (leakage) as a fraction of stored energy lost per minute, modeled as E[t] = (1 - self_discharge * dt) * E[t-1]; dt on the same minutes basis. Units: 1/min.

standing_loss.description: Constant standing-loss power drawn by the storage system: reduces effective charging power and increases power drawn when discharging. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

dynamic_injector.description: ID of the corresponding dynamic injection device, if any.
